Bombardier S Stock London Underground
=====================================

Source model
------------

Title:   Bombardier S Stock London Underground
Author:  timblewee (https://sketchfab.com/timblewee)
Source:  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bombardier-s-stock-london-underground-a6718eff2dc843c48fd54376b4c70b06
Licence: CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

Required credit, reproduced verbatim from the download
------------------------------------------------------

This work is based on "Bombardier S Stock London Underground"
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bombardier-s-stock-london-underground-a6718eff2dc843c48fd54376b4c70b06)
by timblewee (https://sketchfab.com/timblewee) licensed under CC-BY-4.0
(http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

This credit must appear in the game credits and anywhere the model or a
derivative of it is shared. Commercial use is permitted by the licence.

Changes made to the source, as CC-BY-4.0 requires be stated
------------------------------------------------------------

What sits in this folder is NOT the untouched Sketchfab download. It was
processed by tools/asset-fetch/clean-sstock.py, which removed three texture
files that this project's hard constraints forbid it from carrying:

  textures/Underground_Logo_baseColor.png          removed
  textures/Underground_Logo_metallicRoughness.png  removed
  textures/Material.001_baseColor.png              removed

The first two are the operator's registered station mark. The third is a door
warning panel set in the operator's corporate typeface. Neither the mark nor
that typeface may appear in this project in any form. See CLAUDE.md and
docs/art-direction.md.

The two materials that used them were emptied of every texture reference, set
to flat neutral painted metal, and renamed:

  Underground_Logo  ->  Station_Mark_Placeholder    (144 triangles)
  Material.001      ->  Door_Warning_Placeholder    (24 triangles)

No geometry was removed. The triangle count is unchanged at 579,544. The
orphaned texture and sampler entries were dropped and all remaining indices
remapped.

textures/Electric_Warning_baseColor.png was kept. It is the generic electrical
hazard triangle of BS EN ISO 7010 W012, carries no lettering and no mark, and
belongs to no operator.

Nothing else was altered. Re-running the script against a fresh download from
the Sketchfab URL above reproduces this folder exactly.
